description: Nucleoid keeps secant scale factors live as angles change
code:
angle = 0
scale = Math.sec(angle)
assert(scale, 1)
angle = Math.PI
assert(scale, -1)
angle = Math.PI / 3
assert(scale, 1 / Math.cos(angle))
angle = 0
assert(scale, 1)
scale

description: Nucleoid maintains independent secant class rules through deletion and recovery
code:
class Direction(angle):
    this.angle = angle
$Direction.scale = Math.sec($Direction.angle)
first = Direction(0)
second = Direction(Math.PI)
assert([first.scale, second.scale], [1, -1])
first.angle = Math.PI
assert([first.scale, second.scale], [-1, -1])
delete first.angle
assert(first.scale, undefined)
assert(second.scale, -1)
first.angle = 0
assert(first.scale, 1)
[first.scale, second.scale]
